name: gpu-voxels
description: GPU-Voxels: volumetric collision detection on the GPU (CUDA backend; Vulkan backend in preparation)

cuda.description: CUDA backend (GVL_BACKEND_CUDA); needs the CUDA toolkit installed

pcl.description: PCL point cloud support and OpenNI2 Kinect input in gpu_voxels_helpers (GVL_WITH_PCL / GVL_WITH_KINECT)

vulkan.description: Vulkan backend headers and allocator (GVL_BACKEND_VULKAN). The Vulkan SDK (VULKAN_SDK: loader, validation layer, glslang) is a separate prerequisite.

tests.description: Unit tests (BUILD_TESTS): GoogleTest for gpu_voxels, Boost.Test and CppUnit for icl_core

viewer.description: Legacy OpenGL viewer (packages/gpu_visualization) - currently not part of the CMake build
